root.command: SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, c.enabled, c.PredictionDisabled, c.AlwaysSendChkUp, c.LastDateSentReminder, c.EmailAddress, c.AltEmailAddress, c.ReminderCount, cu.NextCoffeeBy, DateDiff("d", Now(), cu.NextCoffeeBy) AS DaysUntilNextCoffee, nr.NextDeliveryDate, DateDiff("d", Now(), nr.NextDeliveryDate) AS DaysUntilDelivery, IIF(c.enabled = True, 'YES', 'NO') AS IsEnabled, IIF(c.PredictionDisabled = True, 'YES', 'NO') AS IsPredictionDisabled, IIF((c.EmailAddress IS NOT NULL AND c.EmailAddress <> '') OR (c.AltEmailAddress IS NOT NULL AND c.AltEmailAddress <> ''), 'YES', 'NO') AS HasEmail FROM (CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) LEFT JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON c.City = nr.CityID WHERE c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ridwaan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Akhalwaya%'

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, c.enabled, c.PredictionDisabled, c.AlwaysSendChkUp, c.LastDateSentReminder, c.EmailAddress, c.AltEmailAddress, c.ReminderCount, cu.NextCoffeeBy, DateDiff("d", Now(), cu.NextCoffeeBy) AS DaysUntilNextCoffee, nr.NextDeliveryDate, DateDiff("d", Now(), nr.NextDeliveryDate) AS DaysUntilDelivery, IIF(c.enabled = True, 'YES', 'NO') AS IsEnabled, IIF(c.PredictionDisabled = True, 'YES', 'NO') AS IsPredictionDisabled, IIF((c.EmailAddress IS NOT NULL AND c.EmailAddress <> '') OR (c.AltEmailAddress IS NOT NULL AND c.AltEmailAddress <> ''), 'YES', 'NO') AS HasEmail FROM (CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) LEFT JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON c.City = nr.CityID WHERE c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ryan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Vermooten%'

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, ro.ID AS RecurringOrderID, ro.ReoccuranceType, ro.[Value], ro.DateLastDone, ro.NextDateRequired, DateDiff("d", Now(), ro.NextDateRequired) AS DaysUntilNextRequired, ro.Enabled AS RecurringOrderEnabled, IIF(ro.NextDateRequired <= DateAdd("d", 9, Now()), 'YES - IN WINDOW', 'NO - OUTSIDE WINDOW') AS InCheckupWindow FROM ReoccuringOrderTbl AS ro INNER JOIN CustomersTbl AS c ON ro.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ridwaan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Akhalwaya%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ryan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Vermooten%' ORDER BY c.CompanyName, ro.NextDateRequired

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, o.RoastDate, DateDiff("d", Now(), o.RoastDate) AS DaysUntilRoast, IIF(o.RoastDate >= Now() AND o.RoastDate <= DateAdd("d", 9, Now()), 'YES - WOULD EXCLUDE', 'NO') AS WouldExclude FROM OrdersTbl AS o INNER JOIN CustomersTbl AS c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE (c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ridwaan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Akhalwaya%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ryan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Vermooten%') AND o.RoastDate >= DateAdd("d", -30, Now()) AND o.RoastDate <= DateAdd("d", 30, Now()) ORDER BY c.CompanyName, o.RoastDate

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, '1. LastDateSentReminder check' AS FilterCondition, IIF((c.LastDateSentReminder IS NULL) OR (c.LastDateSentReminder <> Now()), 'PASS', 'FAIL') AS Result, c.LastDateSentReminder AS CurrentValue FROM CustomersTbl AS c WHERE c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ridwaan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Akhalwaya%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ryan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Vermooten%'
UNION ALL
SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, '2. enabled = True' AS FilterCondition, IIF(c.enabled = True, 'PASS', 'FAIL') AS Result, IIF(c.enabled = True, 'TRUE', 'FALSE') AS CurrentValue FROM CustomersTbl AS c WHERE c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ridwaan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Akhalwaya%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ryan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Vermooten%'
UNION ALL
SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, '3. PredictionDisabled = False' AS FilterCondition, IIF(c.PredictionDisabled = False, 'PASS', 'FAIL') AS Result, IIF(c.PredictionDisabled = True, 'TRUE (FAILING)', 'FALSE (OK)') AS CurrentValue FROM CustomersTbl AS c WHERE c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ridwaan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Akhalwaya%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ryan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Vermooten%'
UNION ALL
SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, '4. NextCoffeeBy > MinReminderDate' AS FilterCondition, IIF(cu.NextCoffeeBy > (SELECT MinReminderDate FROM SysDataTbl WHERE ID=1), 'PASS', 'FAIL') AS Result, Format(cu.NextCoffeeBy, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS CurrentValue FROM CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID WHERE c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ridwaan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Akhalwaya%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ryan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Vermooten%'
UNION ALL
SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, '5. NextCoffeeBy in window (6-10 days)' AS FilterCondition, IIF(cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 10, Now()), 'PASS', 'FAIL - OUTSIDE WINDOW') AS Result, 'Days until: ' & CStr(DateDiff("d", Now(), cu.NextCoffeeBy)) AS CurrentValue FROM CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID WHERE c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ridwaan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Akhalwaya%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ryan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Vermooten%'
UNION ALL
SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, '6. Has Email Address' AS FilterCondition, IIF((c.EmailAddress IS NOT NULL AND c.EmailAddress <> '') OR (c.AltEmailAddress IS NOT NULL AND c.AltEmailAddress <> ''), 'PASS', 'FAIL') AS Result, c.EmailAddress AS CurrentValue FROM CustomersTbl AS c WHERE c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ridwaan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Akhalwaya%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ryan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Vermooten%'
ORDER BY CustomerID, FilterCondition

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, cu.NextCoffeeBy, nr.NextDeliveryDate, DateAdd("d", 9, cu.NextCoffeeBy) AS CoffeeByPlus9Days, IIF(nr.NextDeliveryDate <= DateAdd("d", 9, cu.NextCoffeeBy), 'YES', 'NO') AS DeliveryInWindow, IIF(nr.NextDeliveryDate >= (SELECT MAX(DateSentReminder) FROM SentRemindersLogTbl WHERE ReminderSent = True), 'YES', 'NO - FILTERED OUT') AS PassesDeliveryDateFilter, IIF(c.AlwaysSendChkUp = True, 'YES - OVERRIDES', 'NO') AS AlwaysSendCheckup FROM (CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) LEFT JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON c.City = nr.CityID WHERE c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ridwaan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Akhalwaya%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ryan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Vermooten%'
